identificationModule.briefTitle: A Clinical Study of SCTB41 Combined With Docetaxel in Patients With Previously Treated Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer（Phase II Study Ongoing）
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II/III Study of SCTB41 Plus Docetaxel vs Placebo Plus Docetaxel in Previously Treated Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to evaluate the safety and efficacy of SCTB41 combined with docetaxel in patients with previously treated non-small cell lung cancer. The Phase II part of this study is an open-label, multicenter clinical trial.

interventions.name: SCTB41
interventions.description: SCTB41 is administered at selected dose by intravenous infusion on Day 1 of each 3-week cycle

interventions.name: docetaxel
interventions.description: docetaxel is administered at selected dose by intravenous infusion on Day 1 of each 3-week cycle

secondaryOutcomes.description: The ORR is defined as the proportion of subjects with confirmed CR or confirmed PR, based on RECIST Version 1.1.
The DCR is defined as the proportion of subjects with CR, PR, or SD based on RECIST Version 1.1.
The PFS is defined as the time from the start of treatment until the first documentation of disease progression or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.
Overall survival is defined as the time from the start of treatment until death due to any cause.
